question:
I am looking for a way to list all the current project ids with an SQL query so that I can later execute it with dbt.

I have tried with extracting the project id from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_ORGANIZATION, but it also contains deleted projects, which I dont have a way to distinguish and since I later acess them in the code it breaks
title: Is there a way to list all the current GCP ressources or project ids from an organization with a sql bigquery query?
answer:
Yes you can, but not out of the box. You have to use Cloud Asset Inventory to export your asset to BigQuery and then query them

I share with you the command for organization level (not documented)

gcloud asset export --organization=<Your Org ID> \
 --content-type=resource \
 --bigquery-table=projects/<your projectID>/datasets/<Your Dataset>/tables/<Your table> \
 --output-bigquery-force

Then, get the cloudresourcemanager.Project resource type to get all your project ID in your organization.
